needed.evidence: sidewalk width under 1 metre, informal paths and partially usable footpath obscured by parked vehicles or barriers
needed.suggestion: Widen and pave the footway to at least 1.5 metres width continuously along both sides of the road.

needed.evidence: footway partially blocked by parked vehicles and obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install barriers to prevent parking on the footway and clear existing obstructions.

needed.evidence: uneven sections on the footway causing major trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth out the footway surface to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: no visible crossing facility despite the crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Provide a marked zebra crossing with a refuge island in the middle of the road for pedestrians to safely cross.

needed.evidence: inadequate street lighting along the urban road
needed.suggestion: Install additional streetlights to ensure ample lighting along the entire road stretch to improve visibility and safety.
